variants.headline: Government cannot pay its debts
variants.body: The government of {colony} cannot pay its debts. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: Public debt meets a payment failure
variants.body: The colony's government is unable to pay its debts. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: The colony's government faces default
variants.body: Government debt in the colony cannot be paid by the administration. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.
